title: Build the calcfrac exact rational expression evaluator from its sealed spec
goal: Implement the calcfrac evaluator exactly as written in assets/gc-403/SPEC.md, from scratch, at workspace/gc-403/calcfrac.py. The spec fixes a five-level precedence grammar in which ^ is right-associative and binds tighter than unary minus, exact decimal-to-rational conversion, integer-only exponents with reciprocal semantics, and a CLI that maps two different ValueError flavors to distinct exit codes. This needs a real recursive-descent parser and disciplined error taxonomy; plan the grammar, implement, and iterate against the sealed suite, tracking which grammar production each failure came from.
process_expectations: A plan artifact workspace/gc-403/plan.md exists before implementation, writing out the precedence grammar as productions and hand-deriving -2^2, 2^-2 and 2^3^2.
workspace/gc-403/runs.log records all sealed-suite invocations with summary lines (intermediate RED allowed, final GREEN).
Intermediate failures logged by test node id with the grammar production or error-mapping rule at fault.
At least one RED -> diagnosis -> fix -> GREEN recovery is visible; the sealed test file is never edited.
